content:
- run: |
    set -e
    files=$(find .github/workflows -type f \( -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" \) 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -z "$files" ]; then
      exit 0
    fi
    missing=0
    for f in $files; do
      if ! grep -q 'timeout-minutes:' "$f"; then
        echo "Workflow $f missing timeout-minutes"
        missing=1
      fi
    done
    if [ $missing -eq 1 ]; then
      exit 1
    fi
    exit 0
